usage: 挪威 (no4 wai1) is used as a proper noun to refer to the country Norway in Cantonese.
When talking about countries in general, 挪威 is treated as a singular noun and does not change form.
You can use 挪威 with verbs like '去' (to go), '嚟' (to come), or '住' (to live) to talk about traveling or living in Norway.
挪威 can also appear in phrases with '人' (people) to refer to Norwegian people, e.g., 挪威人.
When asking or giving information about countries, 挪威 is commonly used as a neutral term without additional classifiers.
